test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 21 Mar 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

1. Surge is a health drink.

2. No health drink is protein.

3. Some proteins are medicines.

**Conclusions:**

Ⅰ. Some proteins are health drinks.

Ⅱ. Some medicines are Surge.

Ⅲ. Some health drinks are Surge.

options.text: All conclusions Ⅰ, Ⅱ and Ⅲ follow.

solution:
Given Statements:

1. Surge is a health drink.

2. No health drink is protein.

3. Some proteins are medicines.

The least possible Venn diagram:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/27c4a58de506e18e73d1bb667b9bb763d5b9cdbf5a69b6eaff905484328558b8.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/102561993b60fb71b43b61f4ea92eb52ada83099cc4f7fda24c4e05f3b38ae27.png] 

Conclusions:

Ⅰ. Some proteins are health drinks. - **False **(Because No health drink is protein, so, Some proteins cannot be health drinks)

Ⅱ. Some medicines are Surge. - False (Because there is no direct relation given between medicines and Surge, so it can be possible but not definite)

Ⅲ. Some health drinks are Surge. - **True **(Because Surge is a health drink. So, Some health drinks are also Surge.)

So, Only conclusion Ⅲ follows.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Only conclusion Ⅲ follows."**
